errors.evidence: The categories on the x-axis are not sorted in alphabetical order. For instance, 'Увеличени...' (starts with 'У') comes before 'Заместване...' (starts with 'З') and 'Използване...' (starts with 'И'), which contradicts Bulgarian alphabetical order.
The description misquotes the category label which is 'Заместване на вносни...' (Substitution of imported...) in the chart.
The vertical axis does not have a label. While the tick values are percentages, there is no overall axis label of '%'.

errors.text_span: най-високият стълб е за „Увеличени работни места“ с 22,9%, следван от „Увеличен износ и...“ с 21,8%, „Заместване на вноси...“ с 10,1%, „Заместване на опасни за...“ с 14,0%, „Използване на...“ с 14,5% и „Енергийна ефективност и...“ с 16,8%
errors.evidence: The sentence uses the phrase 'followed by' ('следван от'), which implies the list is ordered by descending value. However, the list presented is not ordered by value (e.g., 21.8% is followed by 10.1%, which is then followed by 14.0%). The list follows the left-to-right order of the bars on the chart, which makes the phrasing misleading and the description of the data enumeration incorrect.
The description omits that the x-axis labels are slanted.
